in_marathi.name: Jadhav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jadhav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jadhav is a Marathi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'jada', meaning 'hair' or 'hero'. In Hindu mythology, Jadhav is a title given to brave warriors, and the name is believed to bring strength, courage, and valor. It is an auspicious name for a boy.
